ticket.subject: Projects page fails to load
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

One of our workspaces shows 'failed to load' on the Projects page since this morning. Our other two workspaces are fine, and a contact at another company says it works for them. The design team lives in that workspace and cannot plan any work today.

Thanks,
Dana

label_notes: bug vs outage: it looks like a failure, but only one workspace of one customer is affected, so bug; core workflow broken with no workaround = P2; blocked today = high.
